title: Microsoft Purview: higher auto-labeling limits for SharePoint sites and simulation, plus new reporting
summary: Hold: the licensing paragraph carries client-side entitlements into service-side auto-labeling, including standalone Azure Information Protection Premium P2. Microsoft's current auto-labeling guidance explicitly separates those entitlements and directs administrators to its service-side licensing matrix. The rollout facts, limits and reporting routes are supported.

claims.claim: The enhancement expands auto-labeling scale, SharePoint targeting, policy management and reporting.
claims.quote: These enhancements expand support for larger SharePoint scopes, improve policy management flexibility, and provide richer visibility into auto-labeling activity.
